    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.3

    "reading": "Serpent, cross, alpha, gamma, epsilon, crescent, omega, alpha, crescent, eta — a zodiacal wheel of beginning and end, the coach as a moving cosmos.",

    "reading": "The number 1: unity, the single road, the one coach that carries many — a monad on wheels, the beginning of all journeys.",
    "languages": ["en", "la"],

    "confidence": 0.3

    "reading": "A stay and a ram: the coach as a place of pause and a leader of the herd, guiding passengers like a flock.",

    "reading": "From a village named Kocs to a fixed station: the coach is a named place in motion, a travelling town.",
    "languages": ["en", "fr", "hu", "la"],
    "source": "Oxford English Dictionary, s.v. 'coach'",
    "confidence": 0.85
  }
